transport: unchanged arbitrary paths/models/types; no parser gates forwarding

security.read: authenticated management session: administrator or observer; server-side authorization
security.write: administrator + CSRF token + If-Match resource revision
security.persist_bodies: no raw body persistence; optional encrypted REDACTED extracted content only
security.upstream_id: allowlisted response headers; bounded and redacted
security.path: redact credential-like segments; omit query; bounded
security.account_snapshot: immutable nonsecret names and identifiers survive account deletion
security.content: administrator AND current capture access_mode=admin; checked on every read/export; no content fields in list or analytics

query.q: literal case-insensitive substring id/account/model; escape SQL LIKE wildcards; max200
query.cursor: opaque started_at+request_id keyset with filter hash and upper tuple; 400 cursor_filter_mismatch if reused with different filters
query.defaults: since=now-24h, until=now; UTC; since<until; max90d; 400 invalid_query otherwise

response.scope: retained_records; cleanup and new refresh may change counts; each response internally consistent

summary.input_tokens: integer|null sum of known records only
summary.output_tokens: integer|null sum of known records only

response.consistency: items and filtered summary read in one SQLite read transaction; UI replaces both atomically

response.untracked_requests: integer since instance start; admission slots exhausted

observation_limits.policy: budget exhausted => partial; discard parsing bytes, preserve forwarding; bounded request metadata, bounded lifecycle markers; never claim lossless capture
observation_limits.terminal_event_loss: finish updates pre-reserved lifecycle slot, never enqueues into byte queue; dirty snapshots retained until committed; no unbounded terminal queue
observation_limits.request_model: bounded JSON inspection only; unknown null; no body mutation
observation_limits.claude: message_start input/cache usage; message_delta output usage; message_stop completion; no double accumulation of cumulative values
observation_limits.database_failure: single writer retries latest coalesced dirty snapshots with 0.1..5s exponential backoff; no raw payload retention; full slots stop observation admissions only
observation_limits.lifecycle_release: only after terminal snapshot committed; idempotent monotonic sequence updates
observation_limits.untracked: increment process-local untracked_requests and show degraded; no fabricated request row
observation_limits.shutdown: 5s bounded flush, then exit; restart reconciles persisted old-instance running records; unpersisted rows may be absent
observation_limits.request_body_budget: 64KiB per admitted request for model metadata; exhausted => model null, request payload untouched
observation_limits.byte_chunk_limit: copy at most remaining global budget; if whole chunk cannot fit, drop observation chunk and mark context partial; original bytes still forwarded
observation_limits.parser_budget_exhausted: preserve transport observation; semantic/usage unknown unless already confirmed; mark context partial; never resume an SSE parser after a byte gap
observation_limits.memory_bound: lifecycle 16MiB + queued chunks 8MiB + parsers <=128MiB + request inspection <=8MiB for parser admitted contexts; no body buffers for non-admitted parser contexts; additional global content buffer16MiB, on exhaustion drop content and mark partial
observation_limits.pending_visibility: pending dirty snapshots are bounded in-memory state, explicitly persist_state=pending; durable query may still show last committed row. Health exposes pending count. Recovery upserts dirty terminal metadata; lost chunks remain partial.

data.idempotency: request_id primary key; upsert only newer sequence; terminal snapshot includes bounded immutable context and may create row if start was not committed
data.cleanup: only terminal rows; age cutoff UTC or rank beyond newest max_records among terminal records; cascade children in one transaction; requests running excluded
data.recovery: old instance running=>interrupted/service_restarted; retain confirmed semantic and usage
data.usage: unknown fields null; known only when input/output valid; partial if one known; totals sum only fully known records; cache fields shown separately using provider semantics
data.latency: monotonic elapsed; first byte vs first recognized text; null for unobserved
data.account_snapshot: physical columns embedded in request_record; no account_snapshot table and no FK to account configuration
data.retention_policy: independent singleton table; not FK from each request
data.write_order: observations and retention mutations serialized on one writer; reads on separate connections in read transactions
data.retention_delete_race: terminal slots released after successful commit; writer processes final updates before cleanup; no older terminal update may resurrect a pruned row
data.query_attention: http_status>=400 OR semantic in failed/incomplete OR transport in failed/interrupted OR cancelled without semantic completed
data.input_tokens_definition: normalized total input tokens; OpenAI/DeepSeek upstream reported total input; Claude input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens when all required values known, missing optional cache fields treated according to protocol presence semantics; no guessed values. Cache display fields are included in normalized input and never added again to total.
entities: request_record with embedded account snapshot and policy revisions
data.tool_retention: tool metadata survives content-only purge; arguments and results deleted with content; parent request deletion cascades tool metadata

record_schema.error_code: safe enum|null no upstream raw message
record_schema.persist_state: pending|committed; local pending projection clearly marked
record_schema.response_id: string|null upstream body response identifier, separate from header request id

result_order: cancelled without semantic completed: client cancellation
ui_contract.health_vs_record: global health never rewrites historical record completeness; per-record missing reason persisted at capture time
ui_contract.filters: active filters always visible; account shortcut resets conflicting filters; header shows retained scope
ui_contract.policy: cancel discards edits; save persists; cleanup uses saved revision; 409 requires reload; preview count estimate, actual count returned
ui_contract.probe: account check emits same observation flow with source=probe; returned request_id links detail; cancel records cancelled; no fabricated completion
ui_contract.prototype: isolated localStorage of account snapshots and observation metadata only; no plaintext API keys; review test responses simulated and marked; no upstream request

schema_source: openapi.json components.schemas; diagrams summarize these physical entities, contract.json defines behavior
probe_response: POST /api/providers/test adds local observation request_id when admitted; nullable if observation unavailable; must not claim a record exists for untracked request

scope.implementation: four batches under one version design

capture.scope: one account_id or *; account deletion does not rewrite snapshots
capture.revision: capture-N ETag; begin freezes revision; update affects new requests; 409 reload required
capture.data: recognized text input/output and tool parameters/results only; multimodal binary/unknown protocol not collected
capture.redaction: remove credentials, Authorization/Cookie and known key fields; optional email and mainland phone masking; redact before encrypt/store/log; failure drops content, not forwarding; cross-chunk tokens require bounded assembly before redaction; patterns do not guarantee all-sensitive-data removal
capture.bounds: 4..1024KiB per request, default64; full redacted text byte cap; mark truncated; global content processing buffer16MiB; binary excluded
capture.storage: AES-GCM using dedicated content key reference and request_id+capture_revision AAD; separate key volume; no plaintext body on disk or in logs
capture.expiry: capture-time expires_at immutable upper bound; policy shortening can shorten existing expiry; extension never resurrects or extends old content; parent request cleanup cascades content
capture.access: current policy deny revokes content access immediately, even for already captured records; observer gets403; audit content reads
capture.tools: tool_name/call_id/type/order as metadata; arguments/results only within encrypted content and permission checks; no executing tools
capture.cancel: partial observed content may remain, marked incomplete; never fabricate tool output or model completion
capture.audit: append-only action metadata; no content values; retention default90days separately; observer cannot read audit or export

association.explicit: X-TraceMason-Session-Id and X-TraceMason-Turn-Id length1..200 allowlisted; local headers stripped before upstream forwarding
association.implicit: same-account unique previous_response_id matching recorded upstream response.id; header request-id is not response.id
association.conflicts: do not merge; association_state=conflict and preserve independent request
association.tools: match call_id only within same account+verified association, distinguish missing result and pruned target
association.retry: never infer retries by similar prompt/time; explicit parent id/retry attempt reserved optional fields, no automatic retries this version
association.privacy: identifiers treated as untrusted bounded metadata, no prompt-similarity session invention
association.tool_roundtrip: call and result may arrive in different HTTP requests. Tool execution belongs to client/external tool. Gateway only observes; no fabricated execution outcome or hidden retries.

relay_policy.semantics: 0 disables total/concurrency limit; nonzero total>=connect; all HTTP/SSE/WS share account concurrency; incoming/outgoing transport progress resets idle; monotonic timers; client cancel closes upstream and releases slot
relay_policy.revision: relay-account-N ETag; freeze with account snapshot at request start; runtime changes affect new requests only
relay_policy.errors: unknown account404; disabled409; saturated429; connect/idle/total timeout504 before headers else terminate stream and record failure; no automatic retry/failover; error payload passthrough from upstream
relay_policy.admission: concurrency rejection is local429 with error_stage=gateway_admission, transport_state=failed; not upstream rejection. Acquisition occurs before upstream connection, release exactly once in finally.

analytics.scope: same retained dataset as requests; filters normalized at service boundary; UTC since inclusive/until exclusive
analytics.p95: nearest-rank ceil(.95*n), finite observed values only; duration only terminal; null for no sample
analytics.drill: return exact normalized predicate with dimension equality + outcome category + absolute time bounds; list accepts same predicate; no string-search approximation
analytics.trend: UTC fixed-width buckets, zero for empty bucket, explicit bucket_start/bucket_end; retention gaps disclosed
analytics.exclusions: no task-success, quality or monetary-value inference
analytics.tools: observed call/result event count and distinct requests with tool events; no tool-success inference; no dedup of repeated call_id across unrelated requests

auth_design.management: bootstrap admin secret loaded from file0600/env, never committed; password-authenticated server session HttpOnly SameSite=Strict; observer secret independently configured; no public registration
auth_design.sessions: POST session/login with role and secret; rate-limited failures; server generates CSRF token; logout invalidates; 8h max session; existing host/origin checks retained
auth_design.authorization: observer GET metadata/query/analytics/health only; admin mutations, tests and exports; admin content additionally subject to capture access policy
auth_design.review: role picker only simulates server authorization; not production authentication
auth_design.gateway: local loopback deployment baseline; downstream public/multi-tenant credential issuance outside version; upstream API keys are not management passwords
auth_design.prototype_limit: Prototype demonstrates authorization with role picker only. Real login/session UI and backend are required in implementation; this prototype never sends real credentials.

endpoints_source: Complete endpoint and schema inventory is openapi.json; endpoints array below covers baseline observation endpoints only.

product_review.full_detail: #interaction/{request_id}; page not drawer; back and reload retain identity
product_review.simulation: all request execution in browser synthetic, 1 logical upstream second=80ms wall time; metrics display logical durations; no external supplier calls
cases: continuous output for cancellation and concurrency
product_review.untracked: saturated observer does not create request row; transport still runs; returns nullable request_id and recorded flag
product_review.role_flow: demo-only credentials admin-demo/viewer-demo; login, wrong password, limited attempts, observer read, logout gate; server implementation must never use these credentials

runtime_actions.retry_writes: admin POST /api/observation/retry-writes requests an immediate bounded writer retry; does not clear actual storage fault
runtime_actions.restart: prototype fault scenario only; production restart remains deployment operation, not a general management API
runtime_actions.fault_injection: review toolbar only; NEVER shipped as production endpoints

exports.recheck: admin role, content access, current policy revision, request existence and content expiry at confirm; 409 invalidates preview; separate read snapshot for download
exports.over_limit: 413 export_too_large; narrow filters or use paginated metadata query

analysis_drill.semantics: terminal duration >= threshold, exact normalized since/until and dimension equality
analysis_drill.upstream_error: upstream HTTP>=400 only; exclude local concurrency/validation
analysis_drill.performance: first_byte, first_text, total separate, null stays null; initial diagnosis is direction for checking, not inferred root cause
